info.title: Global Flight Analytics Public API
info.description: Complete source-backed OpenAPI contract for all 38 production public operations: 37 stable reads and one protected Route Intelligence mutation. The internal metrics endpoint remains excluded.

servers.description: Same-origin relative server. Deployment origin is selected by the client.

XRequestID.description: Correlation identifier generated or propagated by the API.

RateLimitLimit.description: Configured request limit for the active window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the active window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the active rate-limit window resets.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required backend dependency or service is unavailable.

InternalServerError.description: The API could not complete the request.

RequestTimeout.description: The request was canceled before completion.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is valid but available evidence is insufficient or exceeds a bounded policy.

GatewayTimeout.description: The bounded backend operation timed out.

MutationAuthenticationRequired.description: Valid X-Internal-API-Key mutation credentials are required.

error.message: Valid internal mutation credentials are required

RouteIntelligenceConflict.description: The computed Route Intelligence result conflicts with previously stored evidence.

error.message: Route Intelligence result conflicts with previously stored evidence

RouteIntelligenceMutationUnavailable.description: Mutation authentication is not configured or the Route Intelligence service is unavailable.

InternalAPIKey.name: X-Internal-API-Key
InternalAPIKey.description: Internal mutation credential. The server stores only a SHA-256 digest; clients send the raw 32–256 character key.
